Description: Aralez Bio is a biotechnology company specializing in the enzymatic synthesis of novel aromatic amino acids. The company develops and produces noncanonical amino acids (ncAAs) for use in drug discovery and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Aralez Bio utilizes proprietary enzyme technology to create diverse aromatic amino acid building blocks that can be incorporated into peptides, small molecules, and other therapeutic compounds. The company's activities include research and development of new enzymatic processes, small-scale production of ncAAs for drug discovery purposes, and larger-scale manufacturing of ncAAs for pharmaceutical applications. Aralez Bio provides its products and services to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies to support the development of new medicines and therapeutics.
